title: My post-apocalyptic idle game about a vending machine now has a Steam page!
author: Mind-First
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/8rjr9cxernth1.png?width=1326&format=png&auto=webp&s=c4918a71d97353b552cc9ad9dc93fb5f9535a553

Small milestone today: the Steam page for **The Last Vending Machine** is live! :D

It’s an idle/incremental game for PC where you crank an abandoned vending machine back to life and start selling to survivors.

You spend the scrap you earn on power upgrades, stock new products, and gradually automate the machine. Meanwhile, a settlement grows around it—coffee keeps people moving, seeds become farms, and your lonely machine becomes the center of a little town.

I’m going for a cozy corner of the apocalypse, where keeping the lights on gives people a reason to stick around.

The game is coming soon, and you can [check it out and wishlist it on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5360810/The_Last_Vending_Machine/).

I’d love to hear what you think of the concept. Happy to answer questions!
